title: LEFTRIGHT data envelope
description: Common wrapper of every Data/**/*.json file. The 'data' object is validated separately against Data/Schema/<type>.schema.json.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at a schema file. Ignored by the game.

type.description: Schema name in PascalCase. Must match a file Data/Schema/<type>.schema.json.

id.description: Unique id inside its type (lower case recommended, e.g. 'default', 'sport_coupe').

version.description: Schema version of this file. Starts at 1 and grows when the struct layout changes incompatibly.

comment.description: Free text for designers. Ignored by the game.

data.description: Payload. Keys are EXACTLY the UPROPERTY names of the target C++ struct.
